summary: The pipeline produced high-quality documentation (26/31 passing) with one concentrated failure: the qps-bench-server sub-agent wrote 依赖関係 (Japanese, U+95A2 U+4FC2) instead of 依赖关系 (Chinese, U+5173 U+7CFB) in 9 of 20 file blocks. This single character-encoding error cascades into 5 failures (R5, P3, S2, S5, S6). All other dimensions — MCP data quality, INDEX assembly, document formatting, coverage (100%), and semantic organization — pass cleanly. The Skill documentation has the correct warning but lacks a mechanical self-correction step in the post-write validation. The highest-priority fix is adding a grep-and-replace step for the Japanese variant in phase3-detail.md Step 4.
